brief.p: Typical views per video in the last 12 months against the year before: story channels 0.81× (3 of 9 up), technical channels 0.77× (5 of 14 up) and personality channels 1.04× (3 of 5 up). Personality channels are holding up best. (Older videos have had longer to collect views, so a ratio near 1× means a channel kept its audience.)
Growing: Boxing Mania (51K → 265K), Fight Story (74K → 299K) and Mark Fighting (59K → 88K). Shrinking: Kombat Capital (150K → 8K), Pro Striking (67K → 22K) and Sean "Muay Thai Guy" Fagan (21K → 7K).

The 10 growing channels make mostly technical breakdowns (20%) and fighter profiles (17%); the 12 shrinking ones lean on technical breakdowns (32%) and fighter profiles (19%). Inside channels that mix formats, below their own usual: fighter profiles (0.83×) and lists and compilations (0.83×). Creators are making more technical breakdowns (23% → 26% of uploads) and less news and talk (15% → 10%) and tutorials (11% → 8%).
On story channels, <10 min fall short (0.94×) and 10–20 min fall short (0.77×). Videos of 20+ minutes are 29% of uploads now, against 25% 3-4 years ago.
Titles that name a fighter do better (1.09× against 0.91×) and titles that are about a woman fighter do better (2.36× against 0.97×).

Biggest jumps over a channel's usual in the last 4 months: "Gervonta Davis vs Mario Barrios Was BRUTAL 😳" (Die Hard Fighting, 2.5M, 208×), "Most Brutal MMA Fights of 2026 😳" (Die Hard Fighting, 3M, 171×) and "Alycia Baumgardner vs Bo Mi Re Shin Was BRUTAL 😳" (Die Hard Fighting, 1.7M, 126×).

Other creators' videos about these fighters are beating their channel's usual: Mona Kimura (9 videos, 20×), Smilla Sundell (3 videos, 15×), Roman Kryklia (2 videos, 11×) and Adrien Broner (4 videos, 8.0×).

Your last 10 uploads: median 34K views, typical length 11 min, 10 of 10 named a fighter in the title. Best: "Dagestan's Bruce Lee — The Perfect Fighter | Asadula Imangazaliev" (597K, 23× your usual). Your latest upload is 7 days old.

headline: Story channels are keeping their views better than technical ones (0.81× against 0.77×); the growing channels mostly make technical breakdowns; titles that are about a woman fighter do 2.36× their channel's usual.
